steps.step: V1. Volunteer signed in on the phone; a new Tolon household reached it by sync
V2. With the server unreachable, the volunteer saved a routine ANC request on the phone; nothing reached the server
V3. After force-stopping and restarting the app while still offline, the request is still on the phone (household shows "Not yet acknowledged by the facility")
V4. Reconnected: exactly one request reached the server with its answers; further syncs created no duplicate
C1. CHO signed in on the phone (after the volunteer's data had synced); the mother's ANC follow-up is planned on the approved 2026-10-23 Dimabi day and shows on her profile
C2. With the server unreachable, the CHO resolved the follow-up from her task on the phone
C3. After restarting the app offline, the resolution is still on the phone (the task stays resolved)
C4. Reconnected: one resolution reached the server, stamped with the CHO and the approved day; the day counts it as completed; further syncs created no duplicate

notes: Offline = the app cannot reach the CHT server (USB port forward removed); the phone itself was not put in airplane mode.
Fixture records (households, mother, plan decisions) were written through the CHT API as the real users; the browser suites cover those steps in the UI.
The phone ends signed in as the CHO (sabukari).
